text: seow: "Strength alone is not context." Partly answered. The seat cites a resistance break already made (ABOVE_STRUCTURE) as context, holds at 2 for lack of confirmation, and names its exit observables, which meets R4/R5 for its case. Still open: the point I raised was the bearish_divergence caution (div_state BEARISH, div_bear_count 2) on day_vol 0.78. The seat declares those outside its method, which is honest, but no seat has read them yet; minervini and oneil, to whom it was addressed, have not answered.
